conventions.eps: eps[s]=1: strand s is to the right of its red strand; strands 0..len(left)-1 are the left word (first = innermost around W_left), the rest the right word (last = innermost around W_right); state = [left eps=0 reversed] W_left [left eps=1] [right eps=0] W_right [right eps=1 reversed]
conventions.term: KLRW element coeff*braid, left_state = source projective, right_state = target projective; dots indexed on the left state
conventions.envelope: index into weights_in_gluing_order; the glued complex is Cone(S_k[shift] -> E_{k-1}) iterated
